parts.text: Design and homologate a Formula E circuit at Tokyo Bay.

APPROVED: Tokyo Bay (FIA-FE-2026-TYO-01), 3150m long, 10.0m minimum width, peak regeneration about 422 kW at Turn 5, with F1_TRACK_CENTRELINE, F1_PIT_ENTRY_SPEED_LIMIT_LANE, F1_WALL_TEMP and F1_TEC3 plus F1_MEDICAL_CENTRE_TEXT and F1_HELIPAD. The Gatekeeper approved it.
Can the Monaco Harbour layout be homologated as it is?

REJECTED: Monaco Harbour's 6.8m chicane is below the 10.0m minimum width. Widen the chicane to at least 10.0m, keep F1_TRACK_CENTRELINE, F1_PIT_ENTRY_SPEED_LIMIT_LANE, F1_WALL_TEMP and F1_TEC3, then re-assess.
REJECTED: the 6.8m harbour chicane is below the 10.0m minimum width.
Widen the chicane to 11m, keep everything else the same, and get Gatekeeper approval.

APPROVED: with the chicane widened to 11m, Monaco Harbour (3330m, peak regeneration about 461 kW, with F1_TRACK_CENTRELINE, F1_PIT_ENTRY_SPEED_LIMIT_LANE, F1_WALL_TEMP and F1_TEC3) passes the Assessor and the Gatekeeper approved it.
